name: PostPush
requirements: Home Assistant with a mailbox sensor
MQTT broker reachable by Home Assistant and PostPush
HomePods or AirPlay speakers reachable from the server
Apple Home speaker access for devices on the same network
limitations: May interrupt existing AirPlay playback during an announcement
Requires mDNS and AirPlay network reachability
MQTT event messages must not be retained
Must not be exposed directly to the public internet
